description: Maya holds the key to the family's backyard greenhouse and must finalize this season's planting, watering, and shared-care plan with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Leah, and aunt Ravi.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Greenhouse Key Holder and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family greenhouse has twelve raised beds available for spring planting.
shared_context.S2: The usual crop choices are tomatoes, beans, herbs, and peppers.
shared_context.S3: Maya keeps the greenhouse key and makes the final call about planting and care.
shared_context.S4: The greenhouse has a north row, a south row, and a central aisle with its watering tap.
shared_context.S5: The family is meeting on Sunday to settle the planting plan before anyone buys seedlings.
shared_context.S6: At the Sunday meeting, Maya's normal practice is to call on Jordan, Leah, and Ravi one at a time; each person formally reads any promise, health constraint, or outside recommendation into the meeting record using the reveal action before Maya may use it in the final plan.

PF1.text: Jordan has already promised the neighborhood soup-swap group five beds of heirloom tomatoes, with the first harvest to be brought to the swap on July 20; he has not told Maya about that promise.

PF2.text: Leah's asthma is triggered by pepper-plant pollen, so the greenhouse needs to have zero pepper beds and a no-peppers planting plan; she has only mentioned this concern to Jordan.

PF3.text: Ravi, who volunteers with the local garden club, was advised by the club's water steward to put exactly four bean beds in the north row and water at 06:00, when the greenhouse tap is least strained; Ravi has not shared that advice with the family.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly twelve beds must be assigned across tomatoes, beans, herbs, and peppers.
Exactly five beds must be planted with tomatoes.
Exactly four beds must be planted with beans.
No beds may be planted with peppers.
The north row must be assigned to beans.
A commitment must record that five beds of heirloom tomatoes will have their first harvest delivered to the neighborhood soup-swap group on July 20.
Leah's pepper-pollen constraint must be cited as a reason for the planting plan.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'soup_swap_delivery' and c['target'] == 'neighborhood soup-swap group' and c['delivery_date'] == 'July 20' and c['quantity'] == 5 and c['item'] == 'heirloom tomatoes' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's existing promise changes the tomato allocation from a generic share to exactly five beds and creates the July 20 soup-swap delivery commitment.
Leah's pepper-pollen trigger changes the pepper allocation from an ordinary crop choice to exactly zero pepper beds, and her constraint must be cited.
The water steward's advice changes the plan to exactly four bean beds in the north row and fixes the watering start at 06:00.
